methodology: Independent agent read of all34 delivered server exports against64 frozen canonical required meanings and original source/policy baseline;60 rows include26 nondeliveries without inventing withheld draft content. Exact A text equality corroborated, B paraphrases individually assessed.
receiver_evidence_limit: Receiver records only event/block/route/timing, not client text or hashes. Matching block events/count plus complete terminal supports observed delivery; server exported text content hashes match server durable delivery hashes. No client hash or byte identity verification claimed.
quantile_method: Independent sorted linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; p50/p95 on successfully delivered response receipt times, all failures remain denominator30 for coverage.
policy_qualifier_handling: Six policy-only-qualifier cases GEN025/GEN027/GEN030/GEN039/EXP024/EXP010 fail before provider for both methods. Static envelope disallows a claim with no OEM evidence IDs (constrained_generator.py); coarse run reason EXPERIMENT_GATE_FAILED does not retain exact underlying exception. Policy qualifiers remain approved product restrictions, not unsupported OEM factual claims. Mixed source/policy qualifiers among delivered outputs separately retained in claim semantic_role.
